```yaml
name: Skill Check & Token Metrics

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  schedule:
    # Run daily at midnight UTC
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

env:
  DOTNET_VERSION: '8.0.x'

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: ${{ env.DOTNET_VERSION }}

      - name: Restore dependencies
        run: dotnet restore

      - name: Build
        run: dotnet build --no-restore --configuration Release

      - name: Run Tests
        run: dotnet test --no-build --configuration Release --logger "trx;LogFileName=test-results.trx"

      - name: Upload Test Results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: test-results
          path: '**/test-results.trx'

  collect-token-metrics:
    needs: build-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'schedule'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: ${{ env.DOTNET_VERSION }}

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Restore dependencies
        run: dotnet restore

      - name: Build Skill Validator
        run: dotnet build --no-restore --configuration Release src/SkillValidator

      - name: Run Skill Evaluation with Metrics Collection
        run: |
          # Simulate running skills and capturing metrics via MetricsCollector
          # In a real scenario, this would invoke the actual skill runs
          dotnet run --project src/SkillValidator -- --collect-metrics --output-dir ./artifacts/metrics
        env:
          # Ensure any necessary API keys for Copilot CLI are available if required for real runs
          # COPILOT_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.COPILOT_TOKEN }}

      - name: Generate Token Usage Data
        run: |
          # Aggregate token metrics from eval workflow artifacts into data/token-usage.json
          # This step assumes generate-token-data.ps1 exists in the repo root or scripts folder
          if [ -f "scripts/generate-token-data.ps1" ]; then
            pwsh -File scripts/generate-token-data.ps1 -InputDir ./artifacts/metrics -OutputFile ./data/token-usage.json
          else
            echo "Warning: generate-token-data.ps1 not found. Skipping token data aggregation."
            mkdir -p ./data
            echo '{"tokens": []}' > ./data/token-usage.json
          fi

      - name: Generate Benchmark Data
        run: |
          # Extended generate-benchmark-data.ps1 to include token fields
          if [ -f "scripts/generate-benchmark-data.ps1" ]; then
            pwsh -File scripts/generate-benchmark-data.ps1 -InputDir ./artifacts/metrics -OutputFile ./data/benchmark-data.json
          else
            echo "Warning: generate-benchmark-data.ps1 not found."
          fi

      - name: Upload Token Data Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: token-usage-data
          path: ./data/token-usage.json
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Upload Benchmark Data Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: benchmark-data
          path: ./data/benchmark-data.json
          retention-days: 30

  deploy-dashboard:
    needs: collect-token-metrics
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'schedule')
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download Token Data
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: token-usage-data
          path: ./data

      - name: Download Benchmark Data
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: benchmark-data
          path: ./data

      - name: Setup Pages
        uses: actions/configure-pages@v4

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          # Upload the dashboard folder (assuming it contains dashboard.html, dashboard.js, token-usage.js)
          # and the data folder
          path: 'docs/dashboard' # Adjust path if dashboard files are located elsewhere

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
```
